summary: Verified BOTH new changes end-to-end on preview. (A) AdminDashboard project cards now show 'X/Y plots sold' header via data-testid dash-soldplots-{project_id} — initial state '0/47' (CVF) and '0/256' (VV); after 1 CVF booking '1/47'; after 3 bookings '3/47'. (B) SellDialog validation fix: (1) empty sale_date -> toast 'Sale date is required'; (2) all rows blank amount -> toast 'Add at least one payment row with an amount'; (3) amount>0 + NO due_date + possession unticked -> booking succeeds (toast 'Sale recorded — accounts & admin notified'). Regression: (4) amount + explicit due_date -> succeeds; (5) amount + 'On Offer of Possession' ticked -> succeeds. Total-Sold match verified: single CVF plot 32 with Grand Total ₹80,79,622.43 -> card 'Total Sold' = ₹80,79,622.43 AND pivot 'NET PAYABLE' TOTAL-tag row 'Sold (booked)' = ₹80,79,622.43 (exact match). After 3 bookings both equal ₹2,45,43,583.37. Cleanup: reverted 3 CVF sold units to available, deleted 3 payments, deleted sale_recorded/payment_received/booking_cancelled notifications. Final DB state: CVF sold=0, payments=0, cancellations=0, related notifications=0. unit.data untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _projects_overview booked = sum(u.total or final_price for sold) — correctly matches the pivot's total-tag pivot sum_sold because that pivot key is the plot's Grand Total column. Verified numerically (single-plot and 3-plot cases).

SellDialog.save() correctly makes due_date optional: filled = schedule.filter(r => Number(r.amount)>0); due_date = on_possession ? 'On Offer of Possession' : (r.due_date || form.sale_date). Toast copy matches spec verbatim.
Toast assertions used [data-sonner-toast] selector (per prior guidance) to avoid page.content() false positives — confirmed reliable.
